name: (03) Serpentis — 2 Intermediate — The Skin of the Adder

system.description:
Your reptilian blood erupts across your body in a mottled scaled hide, your limbs lengthening into whiplike, serpentine flexibility — a monstrous hybrid of humanoid and snake.

Spend one Blood Trait and one Willpower Trait; the change overtakes you at the end of the turn and remains until you revert or until the next sunrise. You gain the bonus Traits Lithe and Tough, and your distended jaw lets your bite inflict an additional wound when you win (not tie) a Simple Test after biting, though you may still feed without extra harm. Your cartilaginous body can squeeze through any opening wide enough for your head. The hideous form gives you the Negative Social Traits Bestial and Repugnant, and rips the Masquerade wide open if mortals see it.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until next sunrise or you revert
